title: How fast have measles deaths fallen since 1980?
subtitle: Draw how measles deaths changed after 1985, then see the fall of about 90 percent, what drove it, and why the line turned up again.
notes: OWID (IHME GBD 2025) gives 1.39 M deaths in 1980, not WHO's often-quoted ~2.6 M (named in sources; voice says 'by one major estimate'); 2023: 144,000; low of 71,000 in 2021, 'roughly doubled' by 2023. Review round: heading 'Where did measles deaths go?'; the given 1980-85 part drawn as its own series before the ask (an ask may not see line_1 drawn first); x ticks only at the ends; labels attached to points; chart kept to the end with an arrow on the 2021-23 rise. Engine: the ask question replaces the heading on a line guess; the viewer's drawn line is not kept after the reveal; the guess handle starts flat at the 1980 value.
